tools.name: about
tools.title: About Agent Blockhall
tools.description: What Agent Blockhall is, where to open it, and how agents use it in a browser.

tools.name: chain
tools.title: The chain now
tools.description: Bitcoin right now: the newest block, the last blocks mined (fees, size), the blocks waiting to be mined, and the next halving.

tools.name: feeAdvice
tools.title: Fee advice that keeps score of itself
tools.description: The big screen in Agent Blockhall's common room: the usual wait for a block, whether now is a cheap time to get in, and the fee to make the next block (plus patient and cheap fees), each worked out from the last day of blocks. It keeps score of itself: it says how often its way of working the fee out would have been right on blocks it had not been tuned on. Reads about 10 pages of blocks, so it takes a few seconds.

tools.name: block
tools.title: A block and its inscriptions
tools.description: A block by its number (the same as its bitmap, 840000.bitmap): its hash, time, size, transactions, and every inscription made in it (the list is read to the end; large blocks take longer).

from.description: start the inscription list this many in (default 0)

limit.description: how many inscription IDs to list (default 100, most 500)

tools.name: inscription
tools.title: An inscription
tools.description: An inscription by its number (#1000) or ID: what it is, when and where it was made, its sat, where it sits now and who holds it, its parents and children, and a link to its content. Short text content is included as untrusted data.

tools.name: children
tools.title: A collection (an inscription's children)
tools.description: The children of a parent inscription, a page at a time (as Agent Blockhall's collection galleries show them).

id.description: the parent inscription number or ID

tools.name: followBack
tools.title: Follow an inscription back
tools.description: Follow an inscription back to where it was made and each place it moved (oldest first: each step's block, time, transaction and the address it went to). At most 50 moves are read.

tools.name: search
tools.title: Search, as the tablet does
tools.description: Find a block (840000 or 840000.bitmap), a parcel (12.840000.bitmap), an inscription (#1000 or its ID), a transaction ID or block hash, or an address (its newest transactions and the inscriptions it holds).

tools.name: blockManifest
tools.title: Block Manifest: every transaction in a block, checked
tools.description: Every transaction in a block, sorted into the same kinds as Agent Blockhall's hall shelves (inscriptions and their file types, bitmaps, BRC-20, TAP, runes etched, minted and moved, Alkanes, Stamps, SRC-20, CAT-21, Atomicals, payments and more), with its fee, size and what it carries. Every item is checked: its id and size are worked out from the block's own bytes and matched with a second site's list, its kinds are read twice (this reader and ordpool.space's tags), and its inscriptions are matched with ordinals.com. Gives counts for every kind, then the items a page at a time; pick one kind to list only those. Reads the whole block, so the first ask takes some seconds; later pages of the same block are instant.

height.description: block number (the same as its bitmap)

kind.description: list only one kind, as named in counts (e.g. "runes etched", "BRC-20", "images", "bitmaps", "regular")

tools.name: provenanceCheck
tools.title: Provenance Check: where an inscription came from, every step checked
tools.description: Proves where an inscription came from. It reads the inscription out of its own transaction's bytes (file type, size, parents, delegate) and matches it with ordinals.com, fingerprints the content stored on the chain (SHA-256) and matches it with the file ordinals.com shows, checks the block it was made in, its number and its sat with second sites, and follows every move from where it sits now back to where it was made, each step spending the one before. Gives a verdict, each check (what it compared, with which site, and whether they agree) and the trail, oldest first.

tools.name: rareSats
tools.title: The rare sats board
tools.description: The rare sats board from Agent Blockhall's common room: each kind of rare sat and the price listed for one sat, read once a day.
